question: Let $a$ and $b$ be positive integers with no common factors. Then

options.A: $a+b$ and $a-b$ have no common factor other than 3, whatever be $a$ and $b$
options.B: $a+b$ and $a-b$ have no common factor greater than 2, whatever be $a$ and $b$
options.C: $a+b$ and $a-b$ have a common factor, whatever be $a$ and $b$
options.D: none of the foregoing statements is correct

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10+2 Level — Sixteenth Edition
